title: Cookie Consent
description: The banner every site owes its visitors: what is stored, two real choices, no dark patterns.
usage: Accept and Decline are the same size and the same visual weight — anything else is a dark pattern with a stylesheet. The copy says what is actually stored, the settings link goes to a real preferences page, and the banner does not return after either choice. Shown here docked inside a stage; on a real page it fixes to the viewport corner.
